_about: Pick'em payout tables (only books marked verified are used) for the competitor-spec features (SCOUT_PICKEM_EV, SCOUT_BEST_SLIPS, SCOUT_SLIP_HEADER math). Read by gradecore.payouts.pickem_config(); the default gradecore.payouts.CONFIG (and every live caller of it) is untouched. Flex tables are keyed by LOSSES -> gross payout multiple (entry fee included). Standard lines only: goblin / demon / promo lines and same-game combinations can pay differently and stay unavailable unless their payout is supplied.

prizepicks.status: NOT VERIFIED (owner rule 2026-11-04, main c865e1b: unknown payouts stay unknown). These are the PrizePicks help-center REFERENCE rates (page dated 2026-10-19), the same numbers as payout_reference.py, which says no EV, stake or settlement may treat a reference rate as the accepted payout. No partner-API response or dated in-app screenshot is recorded, and the partial Flex tiers (1.5x, 2x, 0.4x) and Flex 2-pick were never seen in-app. pickem_config() leaves this book out, so every PrizePicks break-even and EV on the new surfaces shows unavailable, matching workspace_rules.ev_status. To verify: record the evidence (API response or dated screenshot) per tier, get the owner to sign off, then set verified true for those tiers only.
caveats: DNPs and reboots reduce the pick count (lower multiplier)
ties can lower the payout one level
goblin / demon / promo / same-game lineups can pay differently
Flex 2-pick appears on the help center but not in the in-app view of 2026-11-05

underdog.status: Verified from the Underdog help center on 2026-10-23 (recorded in gradecore/payouts.py UD_*). A re-read on 2026-11-05 was refused by the site (HTTP 403) and was not worked around; the 2026-10-23 table stands.
